dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Moderately concave trailing edge following a parabolic spline from the dorsal ridge to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a medium pixel radius at the highest vertical point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximate 40-degree slope relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: 1.4:1 ratio of maximum base width to maximum vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Large radius convex spline forming a smooth, bulbous melon contour.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short proportional length with high thickness relative to the melon inflection point.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle of approximately 155 degrees at the melon-rostrum transition.

other_distinctive_markers: Uniform cyan luminescence with high-intensity emissive highlights along the dorsal and lateral pixel fields.
